title: Optus suffers fresh triple-zero outage in NSW as police check welfare of callers
summary: Telco says nine triple-zero calls failed during outage in Dapto region and apologises to customers Optus is investigating a fresh triple-zero outage, this time in the Dapto region of NSW. The telco said an issue with a mobile phone tower in Dapto had affected calls made between 3am and 12.20pm on Sunday, including those to the triple-zero network. Continue reading...

title: High standard of English to be required for leave to remain, Mahmood to pledge
summary: Home secretary to set out proposed tougher conditions including not taking benefits and ‘spotless’ criminal record Criminals and people who cannot speak English to “a high standard” will be denied permission to settle in the UK, Shabana Mahmood will announce on Monday, in proposals intended to contain the growing electoral threat from Reform UK. In a speech framing herself as a “tough home secretary”, Mahmood will say people seeking indefinite leave to remain (ILR) will have to demonstrate they have integrated and “contributed” to society through national insurance payments and voluntary work, and not relied on benefits. Continue reading...

title: Reeves to promise paid work placements for unemployed young people
summary: The chancellor will commit to "the abolition of long-term youth unemployment" in her speech at Labour conference.

title: Microsoft Disables Some Services to Israel’s Defense Ministry
summary: Microsoft said it found that Israel was violating some terms of service for its products and that it does “not provide technology to facilitate mass surveillance of civilians.”

title: Suspect held in waterfront bar shooting that left 3 dead in North Carolina
summary: The attack took place at the American Fish Company, a bar and live-music venue. Police are asking anyone who witnessed the shooting to contact them.

title: UN imposes 'snapback' sanctions on a hungrier, poorer and more anxious Iran
summary: The United Nations reimposed sanctions on Iran early Sunday over its nuclear program, further squeezing the Islamic Republic as its people increasingly find themselves priced out of the food they need to survive and worried about their futures.

title: Netanyahu to Meet Trump as US Intensifies Gaza Ceasefire Push
summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is set to hold a crucial White House meeting with US President Donald Trump on Monday amid assertions from Washington that an ambitious plan to end the war in Gaza is nearly complete.
